arxiv-2006-01543.title: A Bayesian Approach to Modelling Multi-Messenger Emission from Blazars using Lepto-Hadronic Kinetic Equations 2019 A Bayesian Approach to Modelling Multi-Messenger Emission from Blazars using Lepto-Hadronic Kinetic Equations – 19
arxiv-2006-01543.creator: Bruno Jiménez-Fernández, H. J. van Eerten
arxiv-2006-01543.description: Abstract Blazar TXS 0506+056 is the main candidate for a coincident neutrino and gamma-ray flare event. In this paper, we present a detailed kinetic lepto-hadronic emission model capable of producing a photon and neutrino spectrum given a set of parameters. Our model includes a range of large-scale geometries and both dynamical and steady-state injection models for electrons and protons.

arxiv-2106-11316.title: Time-resolved ARPES on cuprates: Tracking the low-energy electrodynamics in the time domain
arxiv-2106-11316.creator: M. Zonno, F. Boschini, A. Damascelli
arxiv-2106-11316.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Zonno, F. Boschini, A. Damascelli. The pursuit of a comprehensive understanding of the dynamical nature of intertwined orders in quantum matter has fueled the development of several new experimental techniques, including time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (TR-ARPES). In this regard, the study of copper-oxide high-temperature superconductors, prototypical quantum materials, has furthered both the technical advancement of the experimental technique, as well as the understanding of their correlated dynamical properties.

arxiv-2203-09139.description: Abstract The application of fast radio bursts (FRBs) as probes to investigate astrophysics and cosmology requires the proper modelling of the dispersion measures of Milky Way ( DM MW {\rm DM_{MW}} ) and host galaxy ( DM host {\rm DM_{host}} ).

arxiv-2302-08842.title: Local setting of spin textures in a granular antiferromagnet
arxiv-2302-08842.creator: Miina Leiviskä, Sarah Jenkins, Richard F. L. Evans, Daria Gusakova, Vincent Baltz
arxiv-2302-08842.description: Abstract Controlling the magnetic order of antiferromagnets is challenging due to their vanishing net magnetization. For this reason, the study of local spin textures in antiferromagnets is restricted by the difficulty in nucleating such states. Here, using atomistic simulations we demonstrate a method for nucleating localized spin textures in the grains of thin film antiferromagnet, γ \gamma -IrMn 3 .

arxiv-2305-10790.title: Listen, Think, and Understand
arxiv-2305-10790.creator: Yuan Gong, Hongyin Luo, Alexander H. Liu, Leonid Karlinsky, James Glass, MIT CSAIL, MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab {yuangong,hyluo,alexhliu,glass}@mit.edu, leonidka@ibm.com
arxiv-2305-10790.description: Abstract The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) systems to perceive and comprehend audio signals is crucial for many applications. Although significant progress has been made in this area since the development of AudioSet, most existing models are designed to map audio inputs to pre-defined, discrete sound label sets.

arxiv-2305-15065.title: Inference-Time Policy Adapters (IPA): Tailoring Extreme-Scale LMs without Fine-tuning
arxiv-2305-15065.creator: Ximing Lu ♡ ♣ Faeze Brahman ♡ ♣ Peter West ♡ ♣ Jaehun Jung ♡
arxiv-2305-15065.description: Abstract While extreme-scale language models have demonstrated exceptional performance on a variety of language tasks, the degree of control over these language models through pure prompting can often be limited. Directly fine-tuning such language models can be effective for tailoring them, but it can be either extremely costly (e.g., GPT-3) or not even feasible for the broader community (e.g., GPT-4).

arxiv-2312-10268.title: Bright and dark breathers of the Benjamin–Ono equation on the traveling periodic background
arxiv-2312-10268.creator: Jinbing Chen, Dmitry E. Pelinovsky
arxiv-2312-10268.description: Abstract . The Benjamin–Ono (BO) equation describes long internal waves of small amplitude in deep fluids. Compared to its counterpart for shallow fluids, the Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation, the BO equation admits exact solutions for the traveling periodic and solitary waves as well as their interactions expressed in elementary (trigonometric and polynomial) functions.

arxiv-2401-02602.title: Neural Causal Abstractions
arxiv-2401-02602.creator: Kevin Xia and Elias Bareinboim
arxiv-2401-02602.description: Abstract The abilities of humans to understand the world in terms of cause and effect relationships, as well as to compress information into abstract concepts, are two hallmark features of human intelligence. These two topics have been studied in tandem in the literature under the rubric of causal abstractions theory.

arxiv-2407-08026.title: Correcting Turbulence-induced Errors in Fiber Positioning for the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Facilities: Mayall astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 )

arxiv-2407-08026.description: Abstract Highly-multiplexed, robotic, fiber-fed spectroscopic surveys are observing tens of millions of stars and galaxies. For many systems, accurate positioning relies on imaging the fibers in the focal plane and feeding that information back to the robotic positioners to correct their positions.

arxiv-2504-15677.title: Affine isoperimetric type inequalities for static convex domains in hyperbolic space
arxiv-2504-15677.creator: Yingxiang Hu, Haizhong Li, Yao Wan, Botong Xu
arxiv-2504-15677.description: Abstract . In this paper, the notion of hyperbolic ellipsoids in hyperbolic space is introduced. Using a natural orthogonal projection from hyperbolic space to Euclidean space, we establish affine isoperimetric type inequalities for static convex domains in hyperbolic space. Moreover, equality of such inequalities is characterized by these hyperbolic ellipsoids. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 52A40, 53C24, 53A15 1.

arxiv-2509-06355.title: A data-driven discretized CS:GO simulation environment to facilitate strategic multi-agent planning research
arxiv-2509-06355.creator: Yunzhe Wang 1,2, Volkan Ustun 1, and Chris McGroarty 3 1 USC Institute for Creative Technologies, Los Angeles, CA, USA 2 Dept. of Computer Science, University of Southern California, Los Angeles, CA, USA 3 U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command, Orlando, FL, USA
arxiv-2509-06355.description: Abstract \WSCpagesetup Wang, Ustun, and McGroarty ABSTRACT Modern simulation environments for complex multi-agent interactions must balance high-fidelity detail with computational efficiency. We present DECOY, a novel multi-agent simulator that abstracts strategic, long-horizon planning in 3D terrains into high-level discretized simulation while preserving low-level environmental fidelity.

arxiv-2511-21315.creator: Jia-Yi Lu, Yi-Qiang Lin, Kai-Xin Ye, Xin-Yu Zhao, Jia-Xin Li, Ya-Nan Zhang, Hao Li, Bai-Jiang Lv, Hui-Qiu Yuan, Guang-Han Cao
arxiv-2511-21315.description: Abstract Recent studies suggest that the tetragonal phase of the Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) bilayer nickelate, La 3 Ni 2 O 7 or La 2 PrNi 2 O 7 , which is stabilized under high pressures, is responsible for high-temperature superconductivity (HTSC).

arxiv-2601-17655.description: Abstract The drying of colloidal suspensions leads to complex deposition patterns, accompanied by instabilities such as cracking and delamination. pmc-10748316.creator: Christian Bailly, Seok-Geun Lee
pmc-10748316.description: The species Fissistigma oldhamii (Hemsl.) Merr. (Annonaceae) has long been used as a traditional herbal medicine in China to treat diverse human diseases. pmc-11518080.title: A global research agenda for understanding the role of alcohol consumption in older women’s lives
pmc-11518080.creator: S McCarthy, H Pittt, K Benjamin, J Stafford, D Keric, G Arnot, S Thomas
pmc-11518080.description: BackgroundThe alcohol industry has targeted women for profit and resisted global efforts to address the impact of alcohol on women’s health. Scholars have called for research that moves beyond individual determinants of alcohol consumption in women, to investigate the range of social, environmental, and commercial factors that may contribute to women’s alcohol attitudes, risk/benefit perceptions, and consumption behaviours.

pmc-11590035.description: BackgroundVaccination is one of the effective measures to prevent latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) from developing into active tuberculosis (TB). pmc-12657177.title: Incline dependence of the power-duration relationship in cross-country skiing
pmc-12657177.creator: Marton Horvath, Erik P. Andersson, Adam Kölnas, Adam Spreitz, Hjalmar Boström, Arvid Sörfeldt, Dan Kuylenstierna
pmc-12657177.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionThis study aimed to develop a methodology for establishing the power–duration relationship in cross-country skiers and to investigate the influence of incline on critical power ( CP ) model parameters.MethodsTwelve trained male cross-country skiers performed four constant work-rate predictive trials on a motor-driven treadmill, using the double poling sub-technique, to determine their power–duration relationships at 2° and 8° inclines in a randomized order. The testing protocol also included maximum speed tests performed at both inclines.

pmc-13313863.title: Identification of an immune-related genes signature in lung adenocarcinoma to predict survival and response to immune checkpoint inhibitors
pmc-13313863.creator: Zeinab Davoodi-Moghaddam, Farideh Jafari-Raddani, Shahram Kordasti, Davood Bashash
